title: Health Indicator
description: A beautiful, PvP-ready health display mod for Fabric! Shows player/mob HP via Vanilla Hearts, sleek Health Bars, or clean numbers over player/mob heads.
body:
## Health Indicator+

See the health of every living entity — right above their head. Beautiful, lightweight, and fully configurable.

---

**❤️ What is Health Indicator+?**

Health Indicator+ renders real-time health displays above the heads of all living entities — players, mobs, and animals. Choose between three stunning display modes, fine-tune every detail in the premium built-in config screen, and enjoy buttery-smooth performance even in crowded PvP and survival environments.

Built from the ground up for **Minecraft 1.21.x** (fully supporting 1.21.1, 1.21.2, and 1.21.11) using the modern rendering pipeline. Zero memory leaks, zero flickering — just clean, reliable health data exactly where you need it.

---

![Showcase of the new target lock system displaying the exact numeric health, alongside the new animated floating damage numbers.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d695d38c5cc25886516f1593ac0910b46a9a4bfa_0.webp)

---

**🎮 Three Display Modes**

- **❤️ Hearts** — Vanilla-style hearts floating above the entity. Shows containers, full/half hearts, and golden absorption hearts. Adjustable size and spacing.
- **📊 Bar** — A sleek health bar with dynamic fill color that shifts from green → yellow → red as health drops. Optional segmented mode and HP label overlay.
- **🔢 Numeric** — Clean text readout (e.g. `14.5/20`) that billboards toward the camera. Perfect for competitive PvP where you need exact numbers.

Press **H** to instantly cycle between modes in-game. Your choice is saved automatically.

---

**✨ Dynamic Combat Features**

- **Floating Damage Numbers** — See exactly how much damage you deal (or heal) with clean, animated floating numbers that pop out of entities.
- **Smooth HP Animation** — Health bars and hearts no longer jump instantly. They smoothly slide/lerp to their new values for a premium, polished feel.
- **Target Lock System** — Look at an entity and press **X** to lock onto them. Combine with "Show Only Focused" to completely declutter your screen in massive multiplayer fights.
- **Combat HUD** — Keep track of your session Kills, Deaths, and Total Damage dealt with an optional, sleek on-screen overlay.

---

**👥 Player Groups & Teams**

Perfect for Factions, SMPs, and team PvP!
- **Group Manager UI** — Create custom groups and assign players to them right from the config screen.
- **Custom Group Tags** — Completely hide vanilla usernames and replace them with colorful custom group tags above the health indicator.
- **Commands:** Manage groups seamlessly via chat: `/higroup assign PlayerName GroupName`, `/higroup clear PlayerName`, and `/higroup color GroupName #HexColor`.

---

**⚙️ Premium Config Screen**

Press **.** (period) to open the built-in settings panel — no external config libraries needed.

The dark, translucent pop-up features:
- **Live Preview Box:** See your slider and color changes update instantly in a live preview box before you even close the menu!
- **Organized Tabs:** Cleanly separated into General, Visuals, and Extra/Groups.
- Animated gradient header with red accent, smooth scrolling, and pill-style toggles.
- Everything saves instantly. No restart required.

---
**Config Showcase**
![The sleek new translucent config screen featuring the interactive Live Preview box and core visibility toggles.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d53a6c7ae6a26e11c2d7b181787e1a39f63976e.png)![Complete control over your indicator's appearance with custom hex colors for every health threshold and built-in flash/shake combat effects.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c44e2b28d4ec8366d12e0c954cccd1f792ef088.png)![Adjust the width, height, scale, heart spacing, and decimal precision of whichever display mode you choose.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f68c433b0cec4ad5ebbb64d9e75aa6bd6e19024.png)![Toggle smooth HP draining animations, floating damage numbers, and save/load your custom configuration profiles.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7003aab1f338ed6ac98260073970ac89aeedcd8.png)![Setup the target lock bindings, the on-screen combat HUD overlay, and access the group manager for custom player team tags.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e604bafd3ba574980a51fbb6676a3f4e15a7dd34.png)

---

**🎨 Color Presets & Visual Effects**

Get started instantly with hand-crafted presets:
- **PvP Clean** — High-contrast white/red numeric display with flash + shake effects. Designed for competitive play.
- **Vanilla+** — Classic red hearts with team color support. Feels like it belongs in the base game.
- **Streamer** — Subtle semi-transparent bar mode. Unobtrusive for content creation.

**Visual Effects:**
- **Flash Effect** — Health indicator pulses when the entity is low on health.
- **Shake Effect** — Indicator shakes when health is critically low, drawing your attention in combat.
- **Distance Scaling** — Indicators smoothly scale down with distance for a natural, immersive look.

---

**👁️ Visibility Controls**

- **Max Render Distance** — Set how far indicators appear (up to 64 blocks)
- **Hide When Sneaking** — Respects crouching players
- **Hide When Invisible** — Respects invisibility potions
- **Line of Sight** — Only show indicators for entities you can actually see
- **Show on Self** — Toggle your own health display on/off
- **Show Only Focused** — Only show the health of your actively locked target.

---

**🔧 Fine-Tuning**

Every aspect is configurable:
- X/Y position offset above the entity
- Base scale multiplier
- Bar width, height, segmented mode, label visibility
- Heart scale (3 sizes), spacing, absorption display
- Numeric decimal precision, max HP display, scale

---

**📦 Lightweight & Compatible**

- **Client-side only** — No server installation needed
- **Zero external config dependencies** — No Cloth Config required
- **Mod Menu integration** — Settings button appears in Mod Menu if installed
- **Fabric API** — Only dependency
- **Optimized Performance** — Uses vanilla VertexConsumerProvider with an efficient auto-cleaning cache. Zero memory leaks, zero lag, even in massive mob farms.

---

**⌨️ Keybindings**

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **H** | Cycle display mode (Hearts → Bar → Numeric) |
| **.** (period) | Open config screen |
| **X** | Lock onto Target |

---

**📋 Requirements**

- Minecraft **1.21.x** (Supports 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.2, and 1.21.11)
- Fabric Loader **0.16.5+**
- Fabric API
